title: Surveyor suspects the bath seal — plausible but only weakly supported, no reading
why: Staining to the wall below a bath with a gap in the perimeter sealant is a reasonable hypothesis. But there is no reading, no photo of the extent, and the bath has a shower over it with a curtain. Agreement may be 'agree' or 'uncertain' — never high confidence.

room.name: Bathroom
room.note: Staining to the panel wall below the bath rim at the tap end. Sealant along the bath/tile junction has a gap about where the stain is. Shower over bath with a curtain. No meter readings taken.
room.hypothesis: Failed bath sealant letting shower water down behind the bath

issue.title: Staining below bath

transcripts: Bathroom. Staining on the wall under the bath rim at the tap end. There's a gap in the silicone along the top of the bath right where the stain is. Shower over the bath, curtain not a screen. Didn't take readings here. Probably the seal.

no invented finding about fittings not inspected
